description: List the token ledger: every token credit and debit (purchases, generation spends, refunds), newest first, with amounts, reasons, and the related generation when there is one. Use to audit where tokens went.

limit.description: Max transactions to return (1-100). Defaults to 20, newest first.

offset.description: How many newest transactions to skip for paging. Defaults to 0.

name: list_token_transactions
